text:
Quick and efficient. They provided me with a diagnosis and a doctor's note in under an hour. Also, the young lady doctor speaks extremely good English - a high level of fluency!

Overall terrific service, and the price was very fair. I didn't feel like they upcharged for the medication or service fees at all, which means I will definitely return if I am sick again. Thanks a lot!
Not helpful at all. Poor in English so they can’t provide you a doctor certificate in English. Not suggested. Only 1 staff was nice to me. Others have no customer service minded.

Good doctor
Reasonable fee
The area is not clean and the staff's clothes are not clean
Very clean and good nurses
Good Doctors.

I went to the clinic because it was nearby. My symptoms had improved enough to walk, so I came early. The counter staff were okay, but the doctor I encountered was very rude. It was like he treated me like I was a stranger. I had food poisoning and couldn't go anywhere all day. When I finally had enough strength to walk, he just told me to go home without examining me or anything. I felt terrible. He didn't talk to me or ask any questions. When he found out my symptoms had improved and I could walk, he came to check on me and asked for a medical certificate. He said I was better and couldn't issue one, and just told me to go home. He didn't listen to me at all. In the end, he called a taxi to a larger hospital instead. They examined me, gave me medication for post-food poisoning recovery, an injection, and a medical certificate allowing me to rest. The doctor at the hospital even asked if I wanted to be admitted or go home to rest, but I didn't want to be admitted and asked to go home. I almost couldn't get back on my own because the hospital had to take me. After resting on the bed for a while and my symptoms improved, the hospital called a taxi for me and even took me to my car in a wheelchair. My symptoms were very severe, and I had walked all the way here because it was nearby so I could rest. I felt awful because the doctor told me to leave after only a minute of seeing him.

(The doctor was an older man.)

The fat nurse did a great job treating the wound. She was cheerful and seemed to have experience in the field. She gave good advice on how to care for my wound. She had a very gentle hand and worked very quickly.

The assistant staff members have unwelcoming faces and speak in an unpleasant manner. There aren't many people, but preparing medication takes hours—3-4 hours—even though there are only 3-4 patients and 5-6 assistants. The wait feels like there are hundreds in line.
The staff were lovely, helpful, and checked my eligibility properly. However, the wait at the doctor's office is very long. If you have a fever, be prepared for a really long wait. 😭 …

I had to come in for a wound cleaning every day because the doctor ordered it. I've been using this service for about a week and I've felt okay every time until today, Wednesday, September 15, 2015. I arrived around 7:20 PM. A fat lady (I don't know if she's a doctor or a nurse) came to clean me up and said I had to come no later than 7:00 PM. I told her I probably wouldn't make it in time, so she said 7:15 PM. I was confused as to why, even though the cutoff time for cases is 7:30 PM, I've been coming at this time every day and never had a problem. When I finished, I asked the nurse at the counter what time they closed, and she told me to come no later than 7:15 PM (even though I've been here every day and they say they close at 7:30 PM, and they just changed it today). She didn't wear gloves when she cleaned my wound. When I said I probably wouldn't be able to come in time, she said I didn't have to come every day, and that I should come every two days, even though the doctor at the hospital ordered that I have to clean my wound every day. I'd like to ask the person in charge here to check this out. I don't know if she was in a hurry to go home or what. Not everyone has free time to come when you want. They've set opening and closing times, and they're on time. They don't change them just because it's late. And regarding cleanliness, they have gloves available for you to use, so wear them. Don't be careless. I don't know what you've been touching. I've been here many times and they all wear gloves. Today, only the fat lady didn't wear them.
The nurses are friendly, enthusiastic, and caring! The clinic is clean and tidy, and the dedication of all the medical staff is truly admirable to us expats! I can't praise them enough!

I had a motorcycle accident and went to the clinic. Nurse Ann took excellent care of me. She was kind, helpful, and cleaned my wound thoroughly. My wound didn't get infected at all. She gave me detailed instructions on how to care for it. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who lives nearby.

The large, dark-skinned Muslim employee who likes to sit in front of the computer—not the one who took my blood pressure—often made faces when speaking and had an impolite tone of voice. I'd seen this in many reviews, but never thought I'd experience it myself. However, the other employees were friendly and smiled at each other. (I was actually going to give 1 star, but I'm adding another star because the nurse was lovely, polite, and attentive.)

The Muslim counter staff were terrible. They spoke with a downcast expression when asking questions. They didn't speak politely and acted as if they were unwilling to provide service. I had to go back to the same Kluaynamthai Hospital I used to use before. Please train this counter staff. It turned people who wanted to use the service into something like this. It was a terrible waste of time. I used the service on 1/12/68 at 4:30 PM.

I just went for a birth control injection. The doctor has a very gentle hand. Plus, I can use my gold card privileges without paying a single baht. The doctor spoke politely and the nurses and assistants spoke well.
The treatment was excellent. The doctor was kind and the nurses took great care of my health. I was very impressed with my experience.
author_name: ชนิตาวินเทจshop เรียช

text: The nurse was very kind and did a great job dressing the wound. She gave excellent advice on wound care and the service was quick and efficient.
author_name: ศิริวรรณ ปาปะกาย

text: The nurses are kind, the service is excellent, the place is clean, the staff are polite, and they do a great job dressing wounds. You won't be disappointed if you use their services here.
The staff are friendly, polite, and provide good service. You might have to wait a while if you arrive late. The doctor is also very helpful.

The doctor was terrible. It was a female doctor with glasses – I regret not getting her name – but I went for a sore throat, redness, and small pus spots on my tonsils. Other places would use a small stick to check my tonsils when I spoke, but this doctor didn't. She just shone a light from a very far away.

Then she said my throat was normal and that gargling with salt water would be enough, no medication needed. I told her I get it often, since I was a child, and last month I ignored it and didn't take medication, which is why it got worse. Now white spots are appearing, and I want medication. The doctor said, "So you want medication, right? I don't want you to take it." I said I didn't want to, but if I didn't take it, it would get worse (I get it often enough to know my symptoms).

The doctor didn't seem to listen at all. She even asked if I could distinguish between bacteria and viruses. I said I didn't know, but I knew it was getting worse; white spots were appearing at the base of my tongue on the left side. She still didn't listen. I then asked if I wanted to have it removed, I'd have to go to a doctor at a bigger hospital, and what the process would be, because it happens very often.

It happens once a month, or even every three months at best. The doctor spoke sarcastically, saying, "If it happens often, go to the hospital. Go ahead."

So I didn't thank him and just left. When I left, he didn't give me any medicine, telling me to buy it myself, saying they were out of medicine. I was so confused!

This was my first and only time using his services. The doctor was terrible, but the counter staff and nurses were nice. And to top it all off, after I got home, I had a fever! Ugh! Just gargle, huh?!

This was my first time there. I read the reviews and prepared myself, and this is what I experienced. I'm giving 3 stars for the nurse who cleaned my wound, but the Muslim counter staff was terrible (extremely terrible, they should be fired, there are many negative reviews). Their speech and facial expressions when patients asked questions were awful. If they don't want to do their job, they should just leave; have some consideration for the elderly. The doctor didn't ask any questions either.
author_name: ณัฐสุภา พูนทอง

text: Very bad. I brought my child to the doctor and forgot my ID card. But after the examination was complete, they told me to bring my ID card. I had to waste time going back to get it. Very bad. Last time I came, I forgot to bring it. It was really bad.

It might be a gamble to get treatment at this clinic. Someday you might be lucky and find a kind and compassionate doctor and nurse.

I checked with the National Health Security Office (NHSO) to see if my Gold Card could be used at this clinic. The NHSO confirmed that my card was available and I could receive treatment at a clinic near my home.

I called to double-check, but they refused treatment. The NHSO then suggested I walk in, but that was also refused. They put me on the phone with an NHSO representative. The clinic manager, Aranya Suwanmanee, asked the NHSO how the clinic would receive the money, since the 5 or 10 baht they returned wasn't even for the doctor's fees.

In the end, I still didn't receive any treatment.

I was very disappointed, starting from the phone call. The way the staff spoke was inappropriate for medical personnel; they spoke like market vendors – even market vendors are more polite. In person, they were unwelcoming.

Other patients, not just me, went there hoping for treatment and healing. Since you are all chosen as medical staff, kindness, smiles, and compassion are extremely important. Don't just be a good person online.

I hope the clinic will improve, and the management should check the service provided by their team. Thank you very much.
The nurses are skilled and provide excellent service. They do a great job dressing the wound. The staff are polite.

At first, I was very worried about using my rights here. I had read about the reviews, so I was prepared for the inconvenience. But when I used the service, the nurses and staff at the counter were very helpful.

The first time I came because my child was sick with RSV, they helped coordinate a transfer to the hospital. I received a referral letter in no time. It was very fast.

The second time, my child was sick with a fever, so I used the same service as before. The nurse asked if I had been tested for COVID-19. I told her I hadn't, thinking I'd get scolded for sure. But the nurse told me if I hadn't been tested, I could buy a test from the pharmacy next door and they'd do it for me. In the end, they did a complete test for me, for both parents and child, at no charge. The nurses and staff at the counter were as good as ever and very friendly.

Excellent. I mean, absolutely terrible.
I went for checkups twice, and both times were awful. I used my 30-baht universal healthcare card.
Especially the elderly male doctor; his attitude was terrible. I understand doctors can be tired, but he spoke so rudely and incessantly. The counter staff were also constantly engrossed in their phones, looking like they'd just had a fight with their spouses.
It's taking forever, hours! I'm going crazy! They even needed two people to help set it up. I'm so confused.

I use this clinic quite often because it's more convenient than going to the hospital. The nurses are lovely and kind, and they can answer my questions very well. Overall, the condition isn't terrible, but it's not great either.
author_name: เพ็ญประภา พลายละหาร

text: This was our first time using social security benefits here. We came with a high fever and sore throat. The counter staff and the doctor provided good service and were polite. However, one elderly nurse who dispensed the medication provided …
I've received treatment here many times and I'm very impressed with the doctors and staff. The nurses provide excellent service and give great advice. I'm giving it 5 stars!

The first day I went to the doctor, I got bitten by a cat. I went to a government hospital and couldn't do anything, it wasn't their time, but I went to get a rabies vaccination and clean the wound. The doctor looked at the wound. The doctor did a great job. He scooped out the wound from where I got bitten by the cat, right down to the bone. But I have to wait and see the wound again on Monday. I'll go see the same doctor again. Thank you very much.
The nurses are lovely, provide excellent and attentive service (highly recommended).
Nurse Ann is incredibly kind and compassionate. The other nurses also took good care of us.

Since my daughter uses her universal healthcare benefits at Police Hospital, we have to use this clinic. I've been to see a doctor here three times already and have never been satisfied. I wanted to request a referral letter to a hospital for further examination.
However, the clinic said they only issue referral letters if the symptoms are severe, and that I would have to wait 2-3 days to receive them. Who can wait that long? Most reviews give it only one star.
The clinic hasn't improved at all. The nurses and counter staff are very rude and the service is terrible.
The auntie did a great job bandaging my wound! I really liked it. She also gave good advice. Everyone is welcome! [Location...]
Convenient location, good treatment, kind nurses...give good advice....staff speak politely.
author_name: สาคร บุรกรณ์

text: There were a lot of people, but the process was very quick. The doctor was kind and provided clear details about the treatment.

April 22, 2024, 2:45 PM. Facing the counter, the female employee on the right constantly made faces, provided terrible service, and wasted money on her wages. Why hire someone to just sit there with a grumpy face? A large, dark-skinned female nurse asked me to pass some documents to her at the back. This employee made a disrespectful face and ignored me, pretending to be deaf and refusing the documents. A little later, the same large nurse asked this employee to return my ID card, and again, she pretended to be deaf and refused. I don't know if it's a matter of personal dislike between them or if she's just inherently ill-mannered.

After complaining to the National Health Security Office (NHSO) about this clinic, I learned that referral letters don't necessarily have to be valid for only one day; they must consider the patient's condition. However, my mother is disabled and has pulmonary embolism, yet they still issued a referral letter valid for only one day, even though her condition could worsen at any time. They even argued that it was a new policy. The nurses lack empathy and common sense in their work, making the overall impression of this On Nut clinic very negative.

The doctor was afraid of catching the disease from the patient. He didn't even ask about symptoms or perform any tests. He just said the patient had tested positive for COVID-19 the day before, but the line was gone today, and then simply …
The nurses took good care of me and provided very good service.

The clinic is quite cramped, unclean, and poorly ventilated.
The counter staff were inattentive, constantly looking down at their phones even though there were three of them sitting there.
When I saw the doctor, he didn't ask many questions.
He just shone a flashlight into my eyes; he didn't even examine my throat. It seemed like he was rushing to get it over with. I was given paracetamol, allergy medication, and artificial tears, with no other advice. If it's like this, I could just treat myself without needing to see a doctor.
Excellent service. Wound healing was fast. Staff were polite...but there was no parking. The nurses were very skilled.

If you're currently infected with COVID-19, I recommend going to the hospital and using your social security benefits.
I went to the clinic and had my test results confirmed, but I had to get another …

I saw a male doctor, wearing glasses and looking older. When I entered the room, he seemed rushed, even though there weren't many people there. He asked only a few questions, then wrote up a prescription without even telling me if the condition was serious. Before I left, he had me do another test. He seemed displeased. After the test, he didn't explain the diagnosis; he just wrote the prescription and told me to leave.

Normally, on weekends (Saturdays and Sundays), I see a doctor who isn't usually there and provides excellent service with detailed explanations. But if I go on weekdays (Monday-Friday), I usually see this doctor. Sometimes the staff at the counter are also rude.

I brought my mother to get her wound cleaned. The service was good; my mother's wound healed quickly. The service was fast. / Just a small suggestion: Please, staff at the counter, smile more. It brings some joy to those who are suffering.
Good service..polite staff..clear explanations...kind doctors..excellent nurses..full marks, no deductions.

text: The nurse did a great job dressing the wound. She explained everything clearly while she was doing it. The clinic was clean and easy to get to.

I sent a family member for general medical treatment... The doctor was sarcastic, and the nurses and staff were unhelpful, letting the patient take their own blood pressure and offering no advice. I read the reviews, and everyone agrees, …

The nurse at the reception counter was nice and polite.
I had to weigh myself, measure my height, and check my blood pressure.

I met a kind doctor and didn't have to wait too long.
